git diff --quiet; then echo \"::error::publish changed $(git diff --name-only | tr '\\n' ' '): run every operation through operate, which ends with check, build and publish\"; exit 1; fi\n      - name: accept only pull requests made through the API (last, so every seal step reports first)\n        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n          AUTHOR: ${{ github.event.pull_request.user.login }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          app='afflom-verdant-studio[bot]'\n          if [ \"$AUTHOR\" != \"$app\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error title=provenance::$AUTHOR opened this pull request, not $app through operate. Every seal step above passed; only the provenance gate refuses it.\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          others=$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR}/commits\" --paginate --jq \".[] | select(.author.login != \\\"$app\\\") | .sha\")\n          if [ -n \"$others\" ]; then\n            echo \"::error::these commits were not made by $app: $others\"\n            exit 1\n          fi\n      - if: github.event_name == 'push'\n        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@56afc609e74202658d3ffba0e8f6dda462b719fa # v3.0.1\n        with:\n          path: app/.prism/site\n\n  pages:\n    if: github.event_name == 'push'\n    needs: studio\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    permissions:\n      pages: write\n      id-token: write\n    environment:\n      name: github-pages\n      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}\n    steps:\n      - id: deployment\n        uses: actions/deploy-pages@d6db90164ac5ed86f2b6aed7e0febac5b3c0c03e # v4.0.5\n"

Do not edit.\n# The one way an agent changes this repository: dispatch this workflow with an\n# operation of the API. It runs the certified command, and opens a pull request\n# as the Verdant Studio GitHub App for the owner to review.\nname: operate\n\non:\n  push:\n    branches: [main]\n    paths: ['model/bindings/**', 'model/encodings/**', 'model/authorities.toml']\n  workflow_dispatch:\n    inputs:\n      args:\n        description: 'The operation and its arguments, e.g. \"stage-bindings target/input/bindings.jsonl\", or \"advance\" to run every operation that next derives'\n        required: true\n        default: 'advance'\n        type: string\n      input:\n        description: 'Optional content, written to target/input/<input_name> before the operation runs'\n        required: false\n        type: string\n      input_name:\n        description: 'File name for input'\n        required: false\n        type: string\n        default: 'input'\n\npermissions:\n  contents: read\n\n# Only operations that write the registers share one group. GitHub keeps one\n# pending run per group, so a staging or propose-command run gets its own.\nconcurrency:\n  group: ${{ (startsWith(inputs.args, 'stage-') || startsWith(inputs.args, 'propose-command')) && format('operate-{0}', github.run_id) || 'operate' }}\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\njobs:\n  operate:\n    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04\n    timeout-minutes: 30\n    steps:\n      - id: app\n        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@5d869da34e18e7287c1daad50e0b8ea0f506ce69 # v1.11.0\n        with:\n          app-id: ${{ vars.VERDANT_STUDIO_APP_ID }}\n          private-key: ${{ secrets.VERDANT_STUDIO_APP_KEY }}\n      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2\n        with:\n          token: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}\n      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38\n        with:\n          node-version: '24'\n      - if: inputs.args == 'propose-command'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.elan\n          key: lean-4.32.2-elan-4.1.2\n      - if: inputs.args == 'propose-command'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3\n      - name: apply a change to the API's own sources, then export it again with Lean (propose-command only)\n        if: inputs.args == 'propose-command'\n        env:\n          INPUT: ${{ inputs.input }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mkdir -p target/input\n          cat > target/input/change.patch <<< \"$INPUT\"\n          outside=$(git apply --numstat target/input/change.patch | cut -f3 | grep -v -e '^studio/src/' -e '^README.md$' || true)\n          if [ -n \"$outside\" ]; then echo \"::error::propose-command changes only studio/src and README.md, not: $outside\"; exit 1; fi\n          git apply target/input/change.patch\n          if [ ! -x \"$HOME/.elan/bin/elan\" ]; then\n            curl -sSfL -o target/elan.tgz https://github.com/leanprover/elan/releases/download/v4.1.2/elan-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz\n            echo \"f81c2e48c1588d4612cd2c8851947898a45ac8d72748a07dff3a5694f1cf589b  target/elan.tgz\" | sha256sum -c -\n            tar -xzf target/elan.tgz -C target\n            target/elan-init -y --no-modify-path --default-toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2\n          fi\n          export PATH=\"$HOME/.elan/bin:$PATH\"\n          test -d \"$HOME/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.32.2\" || elan toolchain install leanprover/lean4:v4.32.2\n          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean\n          ll=\"$PWD/target/lexlean/bin/lexlean\"\n          if ! (cd studio && \"$ll\" lock && \"$ll\" check && \"$ll\" production build --request production-request.json) > target/export.log 2>&1; then\n            grep -m 20 'error' target/export.log | sed 's/^/::error::/'\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          rm -rf certified\n          cp -r studio/.lexlean/production/*/ certified\n          rm -f certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.lock\n          { echo \"proposed a change to the API's sources, exported again as $(basename studio/.lexlean/production/*/)\"; git diff --stat -- studio/src README.md; } > target/operation.txt\n      - id: command\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/release/verdant_studio\n          key: verdant-studio-${{ hashFiles('certified/**') }}\n      - uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: ~/.npm\n          key: npm-prism-code-0.11.1\n      - if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        uses: actions/cache@5a3ec84eff668545956fd18022155c47e93e2684 # v4.2.3\n        with:\n          path: target/lexlean\n          key: lexlean-0.4.3\n      - name: replay the certified bundle, then build its command (only when certified/ changed)\n        if: steps.command.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -x target/lexlean/bin/lexlean || cargo install --locked --version 0.4.3 lexlean --root target/lexlean\n          target/lexlean/bin/lexlean production verify-artifact certified\n          cargo build --release --manifest-path certified/packages/rust-std/verdant_studio/Cargo.toml --target-dir target\n      - name: run the operation, then check, build and publish through the API, as the studio check does\n        env:\n          ARGS: ${{ inputs.args || 'advance' }}\n          INPUT: ${{ inputs.input }}\n          INPUT_NAME: ${{ inputs.input_name }}\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail -f\n          if [ \"$ARGS\" = advance ]; then\n            for pr in $(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls?state=open&per_page=100\" --jq '.[] | select(.title == \"verdant_studio advance\") | .number'); do\n              if [ \"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${pr}\" --jq .mergeable_state)\" = dirty ]; then\n                gh api --silent -X PATCH \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${pr}\" -f state=closed\n                echo \"::notice::closed advance pull request #${pr}: it conflicts with main, and this run supersedes it\"\n              else\n                echo \"::notice::advance pull request #${pr} is open; its merge changes model/authorities.toml, which runs advance again\"\n                exit 0\n              fi\n            done\n          fi\n          if [ -n \"$INPUT\" ] && [ \"$ARGS\" != propose-command ]; then\n            case \"$INPUT_NAME\" in */*|.*|'') echo \"input_name must be a plain file name\" >&2; exit 1;; esac\n            mkdir -p target/input; cat > \"target/input/$INPUT_NAME\" <<< \"$INPUT\"\n          fi\n          if [ \"$ARGS\" = propose-command ]; then\n            cat target/operation.txt\n          elif [ \"$ARGS\" = advance ]; then\n            : > target/operation.txt\n            last=''\n            skipped=''\n            while op=$(target/release/verdant_studio next $skipped) && [ -n \"$op\" ]; do\n              if [ \"$op\" = \"$last\" ]; then echo \"::error::$op did not settle\"; exit 1; fi\n              if target/release/verdant_studio $op | tee -a target/operation.txt; then\n                last=$op\n              else\n                binding=${op#* }\n                echo \"::warning::$op was refused; the other bindings continue\"\n                echo \"refused: $op\" >> target/operation.txt\n                git clean -fdq -- \"authorities/$(basename \"$binding\" .json)\"\n                skipped=\"$skipped $binding\"\n              fi\n            done\n          else\n            target/release/verdant_studio $ARGS | tee target/operation.txt\n          fi\n          target/release/verdant_studio check\n          target/release/verdant_studio build\n          target/release/verdant_studio publish\n      - name: open a pull request as the Verdant Studio app\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app.outputs.token }}\n          SLUG: ${{ steps.app.outputs.app-slug }}\n          ARGS: ${{ inputs.args || 'advance' }}\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git add -A\n          if git diff --cached --quiet; then echo \"no change\"; exit 0; fi\n          id=$(gh api \"users/${SLUG}[bot]\" --jq .id)\n          git -c user.name=\"${SLUG}[bot]\" -c user.email=\"${id}+${SLUG}[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\" commit -q -F - <<MSG\n          verdant_studio $ARGS\n\n          $(cat target/operation.txt)\n          MSG\n          branch=\"studio/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          if ! git push origin \"HEAD:refs/heads/${branch}\" 2> target/push.err; then\n            grep -E 'GH013|error|rejected|path:' target/push.err | head -20 | sed 's/^/::error::/'\n            exit 1\n          fi\n          gh pr create --head \"$branch\" --base main --title \"verdant_studio $ARGS\" --body-file target/operation.txt\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/rules/branches/main\" > target/rules.json\n          if [ \"$ARGS\" = propose-command ]; then\n            echo \"::notice::a change to the API itself waits for the owner's review\"\n          elif [ \"$(target/release/verdant_studio merge-gate target/rules.json)\" = merge ]; then\n            gh pr merge \"$branch\" --auto --squash --delete-branch\n          else\n            echo \"::notice::main does not require the studio check, so this pull request waits for the owner's merge\"\n          fi\n"
